title: 本湖固定统计窗全序列合格月原生像元几何
bounds_semantics: native source raster envelope, not the KMZ statistical mask or lake boundary
qualification: Existing frozen dual95 fixed-window ledger; no new filtering
geometry_rule: Polygonize original JRC class 2 native cells within frozen zone_KMZ pixel-center mask. Exact native pixel edges, no smoothing or morphological fill. Not clipped to vector boundary, so geometry matches the frozen area mask. Differential class change only on cells valid in both months. weights_ha from frozen NPZ.
notes: 1984-01–03 are explicit pre-product slots; no inferred geometry.
All 72 qualified months are included, not only 11 samples; 59 primary months and classification-dispute flags retained.
Empty water feature with geometry_available=true means observed zero, not missing or proof of a dry lake.
Unqualified months have geometry_available=false; no class geometry is fabricated for those months.
No-data polygons cover class 0 inside the frozen native pixel-center KMZ mask only.
Published geodesic pixel-weight area is preserved, not recomputed from planar polygon area.
monthly.json has_water_geometry is a legacy 11-sample availability field; use this index geometry_available for this export.
This export losslessly packages already-published native-pixel GeoJSON. Original NPZ is not present in this checkout; no claim of a new raw-raster recomputation.
Historical products are monthly classifications, not individual image acquisition dates; 2025/2026 are not represented.
